data.answer:
The 2015 mining study found that:
- **Publicly funded entities co-filed most often:** 21 per cent collaborated with other entities.[1]
- **METS firms co-filed least often:** 3.6 per cent collaborated.[2]

Collaboration was measured using patent applications with more than one applicant. These results cover only Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) applications, so they are not comprehensive measures of mining collaboration.[3]

citations.quote: METS firms collaborate the least (3.6 per cent) and publicly funded collaborate the most (21 per cent).

claims.text: Publicly funded entities had the highest co-filing rate in the 2015 mining study, at 21 per cent.

These results are based on the subset comprising PCT applications only so is not comprehensive but does provide an excellent indication.
